voiceover:
[conversational] Claude drafts your Instagram work in minutes, but never let it send DMs.

Stay till the end, because one kind of DM should never go out unedited.

Claude can't see your Instagram, so you paste things in.

Step 1. In claude.ai, open Projects, click New project, name it Instagram manager. In Instructions, paste your brand voice, your offer, and the rule: draft only, never claim a reply was sent. Upload 10 to 20 past captions.

Step 2. Ask: "Rewrite my bio in 4 versions, keep it under 150 characters, with a clear call to action." Then ask for a 4-week content calendar. Then paste one DM and ask for a draft reply.

[playful] Step 3. Read every draft, copy it into Instagram, and send it yourself. Strip customer names first.

[serious] Complaints, refunds, legal, health or money DMs: never send those from a draft you haven't edited.

Which DM would you never let AI touch?

Send this to the friend who types every DM reply from scratch.

Hack saved?

topic: Use Claude as a part-time Instagram manager: sharpen your bio, plan a content calendar, and draft DM replies in your brand voice, with a 3-step setup and where to keep a human check

pick.topic: Use Claude as a part-time Instagram manager: sharpen your bio, plan a content calendar, and draft DM replies in your brand voice, with a 3-step setup and where to keep a human check
pick.angle: Stop paying a social media manager for what Claude drafts in 5 minutes, but never let it send DM replies unreviewed
pick.why: 226k views with 6,709 comments and 5,071 likes, the strongest comment-to-view ratio of the business-relevant reels. It is a pure marketing and growth workflow that fits the 40% marketing slice. Instagram growth is core to our audience, and it is easy to show in 3 steps: bio, content plan, DM replies.

research.tool: Claude (claude.ai chat with Projects and Instructions) used as a drafting assistant for Instagram. No native Instagram integration exists.
research.availability: <cite index='50-3'>Free plan is $0 with Projects up to 5; Pro adds more usage.</cite> Drafting works on web, desktop and mobile with no connector. Auto-posting and DM access need a third-party connector, and that is not needed for this workflow.
steps: Step 1, set up: In claude.ai, open Projects from the left sidebar and click New project (top-right). Name it 'Instagram manager'. Open the Instructions panel, click the edit icon ('Set project instructions') and paste your brand voice, audience, offer, words you use or avoid, and the rule 'draft only, never claim a reply was sent'. Upload 10-20 past captions and your best past DM replies as project files.

Step 2, three prompts in that Project: (a) 'Rewrite my bio in 4 versions, keep it under 150 characters, with a clear call to action.' (b) 'Plan a 4-week content calendar: 3 posts a week, hook, format, caption draft and CTA, built around [pillars].' (c) Paste one customer DM and ask 'Draft a reply in my brand voice, plus a shorter version, and flag anything I need to check, such as price, stock, refunds or complaints.'

Step 3, human check: Read every DM draft yourself. Copy it into the Instagram app and press send from your own account. Check prices, promises and tone. Never route sensitive DMs (complaints, refunds, legal, health or money topics) through a draft you haven't edited. Don't connect an auto-send connector.
Optional: set account-wide voice rules. Click your initials in the lower-left corner, then Settings, then 'Your Claude' (or 'Account' in the older layout), then the 'Instructions' box.
facts: <cite index='9-3'>One source says Claude has no Instagram connector in its directory, and Meta's own MCP covers ads only.</cite> Other third-party connectors (Porter, Metricool, Upload-Post, PostFast, Markifact, Composio) exist, but they are separate products. So Claude can draft Instagram content but doesn't manage the account on its own.
<cite index='8-5'>In a regular chat, Claude has no access to your Instagram account.</cite>
<cite index='6-1'>Claude cannot reach Instagram on its own, so you add a connector that holds your Instagram connection.</cite>

The reel's caption credits its video and avatar editing to Higgsfield's MCP. <cite index='10-3,10-4'>Higgsfield connects to Claude as a custom connector with the URL https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp.</cite> <cite index='10-6'>An active paid subscription is required.</cite> That connector generates images, video and audio. It doesn't manage Instagram.
<cite index='14-6'>Anything generated through Higgsfield MCP deducts credits at standard rates; unlimited access applies only on higgsfield.ai.</cite>

Claude pricing per third-party trackers (read the live page for exact numbers): <cite index='25-12'>Pro costs $20 a month, or about $17 a month when you pay $200 for the year up front.</cite> <cite index='21-4'>Max tiers are $100 or $200 per month.</cite> Some trackers also call the $200 tier 'Ultra', so don't quote the Max/Ultra naming.
The official pricing page lists Projects as 'Up to 5' on Free. <cite index='50-3'>Its Free column shows 'Claude Design, Slides, Docs', and Pro adds Claude Code and Projects.</cite>
<cite index='50-6'>Pro gives you at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free.</cite>

Meta's DM rules (via third-party summaries of Meta's docs): <cite index='40-1'>an automated reply has to go out within 24 hours of the customer's last message, and only a person can reply after that, for up to 7 days.</cite>
<cite index='41-7'>Meta scopes the human agent tag to a human manually answering an inquiry that couldn't be resolved in the standard window, and it needs its own App Review.</cite>
<cite index='40-7'>The rules include a path to a human and a bot disclosure where the law requires one, such as for users in California and Germany.</cite>
<cite index='48-1'>Meta says Instagram Messaging apps 'must have an escalation path to a human agent'.</cite>

Connectors with an approval step exist. For example, <cite index='2-6'>Porter's connector asks before writing anything to Instagram, so Claude drafts the reply, comment or post and waits for your yes.</cite> Draft-then-approve is the safe pattern, and it supports the reel's angle.
<cite index='6-8'>Claude's Free plan allows one custom connector added by URL.</cite>

<cite index='35-1,35-2'>Instructions are account-wide settings; to set them, click your initials in the lower left corner.</cite> The label differs by Settings layout: 'Instructions' under 'Your Claude', or 'Instructions for Claude' in the older layout.
Instagram bio limit is 150 characters. This is general knowledge and was not re-verified in this search, so check help.instagram.com before stating it on screen.
do_not_claim: 'Claude can now manage your Instagram.' Claude has no native Instagram or DM access. The reel is a Higgsfield MCP promo ('Avatar & Video Editing fully automated with @higgsfield.ai MCP').
'Your profile, content and conversations start working together.' This is marketing language. No verified feature links them.
That Claude reads, sends or monitors your DMs by itself in a normal chat. It can't. You paste the text in.
That Claude replaces a social media manager. There is no source for this. It drafts text. It doesn't handle community management, reporting, shooting or accountability.
'In 5 minutes' as a guaranteed time. Say 'a first draft in minutes' and don't present it as a measured result.
That Higgsfield or any connector is free or unlimited through Claude. Higgsfield needs a paid plan, and MCP generations use credits.
That the Instagram connector exists in Claude's official directory. One source says it doesn't, and others describe third-party connectors, so this is conflicting.
Any claim that Claude learns your voice automatically. It follows what you put in instructions and uploaded examples.
The exact Max and Ultra naming and prices. Sources conflict on the labels, so only quote Free and Pro.
Any claim about follower growth or engagement results. None are sourced.
criticism: Claude can't see your Instagram. You must paste in DMs, captions and analytics, or add a third-party connector that gets access to your account.
Meta limits automated DMs. <cite index='40-1'>Automated replies must go out within 24 hours of the customer's last message.</cite> The human agent tag is for real people, not bots.
<cite index='45-6'>Using Meta's message tags outside their approved purpose can result in restrictions on the account's ability to send messages.</cite>
Disclosure and compliance rules for bots apply in some places (California, Germany), so unreviewed AI replies carry legal and brand risk.

Free plan limits: <cite index='50-3'>Projects are capped at 'Up to 5'</cite> and usage is limited. One help-center snippet says project instructions are paid-only, while other sources say Free gets them, so check before claiming the setup is 100% free.
Pasting customer DMs into any AI tool is a privacy decision. Remove names and personal data first. (Writer caution, not sourced in this search.)

ui.platforms: Web (claude.ai) and iOS/Android Claude app. Projects and Instructions are on both. The Instagram step happens in the Instagram mobile app.
apps: Instagram app (iOS/Android) for the bio edit and sending DMs
screens: claude.ai: left sidebar with New chat, Chats, Projects (exact order and extra items change over time; recreate loosely). Profile circle with your initials sits at the bottom-left of the sidebar. Verified: the help article says to click your initials in the lower left corner, then Settings.
Projects page: header 'Projects', blue/orange 'New project' button at top-right (per third-party guide). Create form has name and description fields.
Inside the project: a chat box at the center-bottom and a right-hand panel with 'Instructions' (edit/pencil icon opens 'Set project instructions') and 'Files'.
Chat view: a prompt box with a '+' button at lower-left (attach files, connectors). Claude's reply shows as text, with the bio options as a numbered list and the calendar as a table or list.
Settings > 'Your Claude' (or 'Account' in the older layout) > 'Instructions' text box for account-wide voice rules.

Instagram app: Profile > Edit profile > Bio field (150 characters), then paste the chosen bio. DMs: paper-plane icon, top-right of the Home feed. Paste the reviewed draft and tap Send. (Instagram UI labels not re-verified in this search.)
Default theme is not verified in this search. Claude web follows the system setting and is commonly light with a warm cream background. Check live before recreating.

research.visuals: Show a Claude Project with the brand-voice instructions, the bio prompt with 3-4 bio options returned, a 7-day calendar table, and a pasted customer DM next to Claude's draft reply. End on a 'Review → copy → send from Instagram yourself' beat. Don't fake Claude sending DMs. A real screen recording of the Claude Project is best, and mocked text is fine for the DM example.

Heading 'Instructions for Claude' and the line about clicking your initials in the lower left corner
'An active paid subscription is required.' Use only to show the reel's tool is separate and paid.

research.notes: The popular reel is mostly an ad for Higgsfield MCP (the 'Comment Claude' link-bait pattern). The 'Claude manages Instagram' framing is misleading, and the transcript wasn't available to check. Our reel should say 'Claude drafts, you send'. That is accurate and fits the angle, with no connector, no extra cost and no ban risk. The Claude UI is changing: Settings labels differ between layouts ('Your Claude' vs 'Account'), Styles are reportedly becoming Skills, and one source says Projects only reached the Free plan in mid-September 2026. Prices come from third-party trackers, because the official pricing page snippet showed no dollar figures. Show the live claude.com/pricing page and read the numbers off it. Only state Free and Pro prices. If the writer says 'never let it send unreviewed', the Meta policy (24-hour window, human escalation path, bot disclosure in some regions) is the verified backing.
